(279)༄༅/ /blo sbyong smon lam byang sems rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: blo sbyong smon lam byang sems rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// thugs bskyed mthar phyin bden pa yis// bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la// byang chub sems mchog skye bar shog /sems can zhe sdang la zhugs dang*// tsha grang dmyal ba myong ba yi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bdag la thim// bdag gi byams pa'i sems dang ni// zhe sdang med pa'i dge rtsa rnams// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin// zhe sdang dmyal ba'i gnas stongs nas// rdo rje rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// me long ye shes mchog thob shog /ser sna 'dod chags la zhugs dang*// yi dwags bkres skoms myong ba yi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras= /bdag gi spong ba'i sems dang ni// 'dod chags med pa'i dge rtsa rnams// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin// ser sna yi dwags gnas stongs nas// padma rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// sor rtog ye shes mchog thob shog /gti mug spyod la zhugs rnams dang*// dud 'gro glen cing lkugs pa yi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras= /bdag gi skyes sbyangs shes rab dang*// gti mug med pa'i= /nam mkha'= /gti mug dud 'gro'i gnas stongs nas// bde gshegs rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// chos dbyings ye shes mchog thob shog /phrag dog khong nas 'khrugs rnams dang*// 'thab cing rtsod pa'i lha min gyi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras= /bdag gi sgo gsum bzod pa dang*// phrag dog med pa'i= /nam mkha' mnyam= /'thab rtsod lha min gnas= /las kyi rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// bya grub ye shes mchog thob shog /nga rgyal sems kyis non rnams dang*// pham ltung myong ba'i lha rnams kyi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras= /(280)bdag gis brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang*// nga rgyal med pa'i= /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i= /pham ltung lha yi gnas=

/rin chen rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs// mnyam nyid ye shes mchog thob shog /thog med las sgrib ji snyad dang*// skye rga na 'chi 'khor ba yi// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras= /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// thog med nas bsags dge rtsa rnams// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i= /brel phongs mi yi gnas stongs nas// chos sku dri med spyan ras gzigs// rang byung ye shes mchog thob shog /so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi// nyams chag nyes ltung bdag la thim// bdag gis sdom gsum bsrungs pa'i dge// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i= /sdom gsum rnam par dag gyur nas// nyams pa'i dri tsam mi 'byung bar// rigs 'dus rdo rje sems thob shog /srog bcad rten gsum gzhig gzhom sogs// tshe thung las sgrib bdag la= /rten gsum bzhengs dang srog bskyabs dge /nam mkha' mnyam= /dus min 'chi ba'i ming mi grags// rdo rje tshe dpag med thob shog /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa sogs// 'gro ba'i nang kun bdag la= /rdeg rdung spangs dang sman sbyin sogs// nad med bde skyid dge rtsa rnams// nam mkha' mnyam= /dug gsum nang sel sman gyi bla// baiḍūrya 'od sku thob shog /rku 'phrog ma byin blangs pa yis// bkres skom dbul phongs bdag la thim// chos nor sbyin 'bras ji snyed pa// nam mkha' mnyam= /'dod dgu 'bad med lhun grub pa// nam mkha' mdzod la longs spyod shog /mi dge 'ba' zhig byas pa yis// ma dag zhing du skye ba yi// las sgrib ji snyed bdag la= /sems bskyed 'gyur ba bcu la sogs// nam mkha' mnyam= /kun kyang mngon dga' bde ldan sogs// dag zhing kho nar skye bar shog /log lta 'ba' zhig bsgoms pa yis// dkon mchog mnyes par mi bgyid pa'i// las sgrib ji snyed bdag=(281)dad pa rnam gsum dge rtsa sogs// nam mkha' mnyam= /bslu med las dang 'bras bu la// yid ches khong nas rdol ba yis// dge sgrub sdig spong byed par shog

/bdag 'dzin 'ba' zhig goms pa yis// rang snang dgra ru lta ba yi// chags sdang ma lus bdag= /tshad med bzhi yi dge rtsa rnams// nam mkha' mnyam= /kun kyang byams pa snying rje dang*// dga' ba btang snyoms sems ldan shog /'khrul snang bden par 'dzin pa'i sems// sdug bsngal 'byung khungs bdag la thims// stong zhing bdag med rtogs pa ni// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro la sbyin// stong nyid zab mo rgyud la skyes// rdzogs sangs go 'phang mchog thob shog /mdor na 'jigs pa bcu drug sogs// mi 'dod pa dang 'phrad pa dang*// nye du zas nor gnas grogs sogs// 'dod pa rnams dang bral ba dang*// dgra 'dul gnyen skyong so nam sogs// yod pa bskyang gis mi longs dang*// mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags sogs// med pa btsal gyis mi rnyed dang*// bar chad blo bur ye 'drogs sogs// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ji snyed pa// bdag gis bdag 'dzin steng du len// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos kun dang*// kha rje dbang thang lus srog bcas// ltos pa med pa 'gro la sbyin// sems can thams cad bde skyid ldan// byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /bdag gis chos bshad dge bskul dang*// sha zos zho 'thung bzhon pa zhon// bdag la dad gus zas nor sbyin// ma dad log lta bkur 'debs dang*// 'phrog bcom rdeg rdung ngan sems 'chang*// bzang ngan las kyis 'brel pa sogs// mdor na bdag lus mthong ba dang*// bdag gi ming thos skyon yon dran// rlung rdzis reg pa'i 'gro kun kyang*// thog med sdig sgrib zad nas ni// 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po yis// bde ba can tu 'dren par shog /(282)bdag gi sgo gsum bya spyod dang*// lus kyi dri ma tshun chad kyis// 'gro phan kho na byed nus shog /bdag gi lus srog la 'tshe ba'i// mi dang mi min gnod sems can// thog ma kho nar 'tshang rgya shog /bdag la brten nas cung zad kyang*// sdig pa'i 'bras bur ma gyur cig

/rmi lam chu zla smig rgyu ltar// brtag na bden par ma grub pa// bdag 'dzin 'di yis thams cad bslus// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun dang*// gdon bgegs mi ma yin la sogs// don dam stong pa nyid du mnyam// stong la bden zhen byed pa 'khrul// kun rdzob pha mar ma gyur med// 'jig rten dag na pha ma las// drin che ba ni gang zhig yod// ma bur gnod sems 'chang ba 'khrul// de bas pha ma sems can ni// phyogs ris med pa'i drin dran pas// khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la sbyin// gyong dang bub kha rang la len// bdag gi lhag bsam 'di yi mthus// thams cad sgrib sbyangs tshogs rdzogs shing*// byang chub sems mchog rin po che// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// phyin ci ma log rgyal ba'i lam// bde blag nyid du skyes nas kyang*// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa'ang blo sbyong la mos pa lam du byed pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis dben pa'i ri ngogs su snying nas smon pa dge// maṅga laṃ/// /
